watermark_spec.free_mode: Shows subtle footer mark 'Created with Quote Flow Free' on client PDFs and public previews

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, status badges, and cards MUST have unique data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure React JS (.js / .jsx files) with standard Tailwind CSS classes.
Follow clean SaaS ergonomics: left dark sidebar navigation, white content cards, blue primary action buttons, notification banner.
Ensure responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop with mobile drawer or collapsible sidebar.
Include PWA install manifest and offline-friendly UI cues.
Always place data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
